description: Brenda Case is a lifelong Southeast Iowan, born and raised in Ottumwa, with deep rural roots and a 28-year career as an IT Project Manager with the Iowa Judicial Branch. A community servant, proud member of a union family, and grandmother of two, Brenda understands firsthand the challenges facing working families, farmers, and rural communities. She's ready to take the fight for fairness, opportunity, and dignity to Des Moines as your District 13 State Senator.
